newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel - LS loses as buyers dry up.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel - LS loses as buyers dry up.

text.p: Low sulphur straight-run fuel oil lost ground on Friday, battered by easier crude and lack of demand.
"It's down around $2 to $125 fob NWE. No one looks interested," said one trader. Most September requirement has now been met and October barrels have not yet enticed buyers.

The overhang that has loomed over the high sulphur straight run has eased and only one or two E-4 now need homes. Prices were assessed around formula +$2-3. M-100 stocks have also been cleared, but not so effectively and three or four are without buyers. One or two may still make it into the barge market.
